_why: The sitemap advertises what we stand behind, not everything that returns 200. Google crawled 112 of these 200 URLs and indexed one; a 200-URL sitemap on a three-day-old domain reads as a thin-content application. This file is the short list. Pages not listed here stay live, stay linked, and stay crawlable — they are simply no longer advertised as priorities. Reversible: delete this file's entries and rebuild.
_measured: 2026-11-04 · apex 1 indexed / 42 crawled-not-indexed / 59 unknown (102 apex URLs) · play 0 indexed / 70 crawled / 28 unknown (98 play URLs). This is the historical 200-URL subset, not the 383-canonical-URL census recorded in the sidecar 07-measure/ audit.
_review: 2026-11-18 — compare index-status snapshots, keep this only if the indexed count moved.
_genrePagesWhy: Real pages at /fgame/<genre> replaced the /fgame/#genre anchors (2026-11-04). They are generated from the same game data as the /fgame/ index, so their lastmod follows the newest game.
_gamesWhy: Every one of the 68 apex /fgame/ pages duplicates a play /game/ page for the same title. Google crawled 17 of them and indexed none. The catalogue is advertised from play; apex keeps /fgame/ as the browse index only. This is a scope decision, not a canonical-conflict remedy: the 2026-11-04 full inspection found cross_host canonical = 0, and Google consistently chose each page's own canonical. Three of those pairs shared an exact slug and are now 301s to play (see public/_redirects); the fourth flagged collision, pacman, was a false positive — apex hosts the 30th Anniversary Google Doodle and play hosts the standard Pac-Man.
_gamesException: 2026-11-04 — the six guides above are the exception, and the only entries in this list. They were added on 2026-11-04 as the first genuinely new two-player titles and they exist ONLY on apex: play.poki2.online's 221-game catalogue has no page for any of them, so these six apex URLs are unique rather than a second copy of an existing play URL. They are also the highest intent match the site owns for the '2 player games' query — six dedicated pages against a hub that otherwise points at 300-word card descriptions. Apex currently has 1 indexed URL and 42 crawled-not-indexed; these are fresh URLs with no crawl history, which is exactly the population a sitemap helps. Sitemap is 26 URLs (20 base + these 6). Remove this list if the index count does not move by the 2026-11-18 review.
